notes.title: Double-sided Aces Demo Update Log - 2025/08/20
notes.notes:
Fixes
Auto Button Issue

Fixed an issue where the Auto button would occasionally fly off the screen. It should now behave more stably.

Black Screen Stuck Issue

During black screen transitions, the story will now automatically proceed to the next segment without requiring extra input.

Yu Hao’s Coffee Choice

Fixed an issue in Yu Hao’s coffee-related story branch where one of the options was not working properly.

PV Skip Function

Added the ability to skip the PV by pressing the Esc key.
